analysis:
This batch changes documentation only. No provider source was supplied, so the review compares the documented behavior with the threat model and does not verify code.

1) docs/architecture/inference.md head 684-691 (GLM5-Next weight hash). Instead of separate WeightHasher passes, the published weight hash is now the manifest aggregate (GLM5NextManagedLoad.verifiedArtifactSHA256). On the next coordinator-mode start, VerifiedWeightHashStore registers that hash without reading the weights, provided every file keeps its device, inode, size, mtime and ctime. This touches A-004, T-012 and T-027 (operator weight substitution) and the T-041 weightHash cache binding.
- The doc says the load re-verifies every file before serving.
- The registration-time hash is already provider-self-reported, so no regression is shown.
- Integration should confirm in code that serving is blocked until full manifest re-verification passes.
- It should also confirm that an operator who resets ctime (for example via clock changes) cannot reach serving with a stale hash.
- It should check that the T-041 SSD cache binding uses the post-verification hash.

2) inference.md head 818-821 and 837. GLM video now indexes variable-frame-rate tracks at i/nominalFrameRate instead of refusing them. This widens the accepted media parsing surface (TB-007, ADV-002). The doc says decoding stays bounded by the 512 MiB maximumDecodedBytes cap and the 28,532 visual-token cap. Media requests stay excluded from prefix capture, so the T-041 cache surface does not change.

3) inference.md head 884-903. For GLM, json response_format and forced tool_choice use prompt steering plus withheld output and post-validation (invalid output returns 422 with no content). It also renders client-returned reasoning into the template. This is a correctness and prompt-content matter, not a boundary change.

4) inference.md head 1740-1759. EngineV2Bridge.nativeOutputControlRefusal refuses unsupported token-constraint or logprob rows as a 400 before any reservation. This prevents a consumer from tripping the coordinator's inference-error breaker, which is availability-positive.

5) hardware-support.md head 248-254. The systemAvailable formula now counts page cache and purgeable pages. This affects admission and availability only; the doc keeps the minimum OS reserve and activation-reserve invariants.

No concrete regression is supported from the documentation alone.
